_README: SCHEMA + EXAMPLE ONLY. Live watchlist withheld (see ../RESPONSIBLE-DISCLOSURE.md). setv1_watch.py reads setv1-targets.example.json by default; copy to setv1-targets.json for your own authorized targets.

_schema.infrastructure: map of {role: {address, note, polled}} - shared Core/TransferProxy/Vault contracts; polled=false means detection runs on the set-token legs, not this contract's top-level tx list
_schema.targets: array of {address, chain, name, ticker, rank, hit_status, note, verified} - the rebalancing sets to watch for the actualizeFee() rounding fingerprint

protocol: EXAMPLE: Set Protocol V1 (deprecated 2021; immutable, no pause/upgrade). Hit twice on 2026-10-06 via the permissionless actualizeFee() rounding exploit (SunWeb3Sec PoC, SlowMist). This documents the PUBLIC incident family; addresses left as placeholders.

core.note: issue/redeem/deposit/internalTransfer; attack calls are INTERNAL so Core top-level tx list misses them

vault.note: single global custodian; donate leg lands here; too noisy to poll directly

targets.name: EXAMPLE rebalancing set
targets.note: replace with sets you are authorized to monitor
